lemmas.primary_translation: shift to a higher gear / increase the level of activity / excite or agitate

definitions.translation: shift to a higher gear (lit. shift up a gear)
figuratively: increase the level of activity

examples.no: om vi ikke girer opp nå, blir vi aldri ferdige
examples.en: if we don't get fired up now, we'll never finish

examples.no: ikke gir opp ungene før leggetid
examples.en: don't wind the kids up before bedtime
